proved.finite_completed_serialization: For gamma=(mu 1_(>U))*(Lambda 1_(>V)), the compactified principal test gives a finite gamma*D_q alias sum plus the exact constant/logarithmic affine residual, with every quadratic cross term retained.
proved.coefficient_cost: |gamma(q)|<=log q, sum |gamma(q)|/q=O(log^2 X), and sum |gamma(q)|^2/q=O(log^3 X).
proved.low_cofactor_suppression: For every D, the total q<=X^(99/100)/4 nonzero-alias field is O_D(X^(-D)) after smooth physical compactification.
proved.surviving_geometry: Arbitrary-power suppression first gives q>=X^(99/100+o(1)) and physical quotient v_phys=n/q<=X^(1/100+o(1)). The target-matched fifth-order collar sharpens the equivalent retained field to q>X^(499/500), 0<|a|<=X^(1/400), and v_phys<=X^(1/500+o(1)); v_phys is not the solution-line Poisson dual, and low, high, and reducible determinants all survive.
proved.target_matched_collar: With Q=floor(X^(499/500)) and A=floor(X^(1/400)), retain the exact affine residual ell_T and only q>Q, 0<|a|<=A. The discarded field is O(X^(49/100) log^2 X), so weighted L2 Minkowski makes this exponent-equivalent to the X^(49/50+o(1)) energy target, not a proved power saving.
proved.mask_cost: The common-g primitive line mask has Fourier-algebra norm at most 3^omega(g)=g^o(1); compatibility of its fractional shifts with an imported integer-phase theorem is not thereby proved.
proved.hostile_actual_subfield: A balanced-semiprime numerator-one principal subfield has energy X/log^2 X=X^(1-o(1)); hence it cannot be estimated separately at exponent 49/50.
proved.top_box_closeout: The principal band retains g=1, M=N=X, J=Theta=X and |j theta|=X^2. The recorded scalar Wright output is X^(15/8+o(1)), worse than the direct X^(1+o(1)) energy scale.

surviving_open_theorem: A single globally signed, actual-coefficient correlation estimate on the target-matched collar q>X^(499/500), 0<|a|<=X^(1/400), v_phys<=X^(1/500+o(1)), with all determinants, conductors, aliases, projector terms, affine or prelocalized-Q_h completion, and cross terms retained, saving X^(-1/50) in energy.
logical_strength: Once the X^(-1/50) conclusion is included for the complete family, the surviving theorem is the R71 endpoint and is uniform-strip-equivalent, not a smaller proved reduction.
literature_verdict: Wright I/II, Blomer-Pascadi, Maynard-Pandey-Radziwill, and the checked almost-all distribution input do not supply the completed estimate.
novelty: LOCAL_PREDECESSOR_PLUS_SHARPENED_PROJECT_SYNTHESIS; no candidate-new or certified literature novelty claim.
formal_scope: Lean checks only rational exponents and finite denominator, determinant, affine, and square-expansion algebra. Python replays the same finite geometry and mask/cross-term guards. Neither formalizes the analytic localization, PNT subfield, imported Kloosterman theorems, or the open fixed-power estimate.
nonclaim: The X^(49/50+o(1)) estimate, a uniform zero-free strip, the sharp four-cycle bound, and RH were not proved.
